profile.summary: Youth ALIVE! is an Oakland nonprofit that works to prevent violence and support people affected by it. Its programs include violence prevention for youth, intervention work with people at risk of violence, and counseling and support for families of homicide victims. Its services are free and community-based.

review.notes: Youth ALIVE! in Oakland is a 501(c)(3) (EIN 94-3143254 per ProPublica), and its own site confirms the violence prevention and youth programs, free services, and the phone, email and address, which fit a no-cost services agreement with Community Schools and Student Services. The summary is neutral and supported; no source names OUSD directly, but name, city and service fit are consistent.
